protocol.sourceArchives: Pinned Git checkouts; original repository package build commands, followed by production ESM assembly.
protocol.workerUse: The LilScript lane ran on a burstable Azure VM that also runs unrelated jobs; timings are contextual wall times, with CPU time recorded separately. The original repository build was not re-run on this host; its record comes from the 2026-09-10 worker named with it.

esm.scope: Pinned PostHog selected kernel source modules via scripts/official-bundle.mjs; not the complete SDK

original.note: Not re-run for this release: on this host one PostHog SDK build ran past 20 minutes under load. Samples from the 2026-09-10 paired source build.

sourceBuild.scopeNote: Original timing covers the complete PostHog SDK and its workspace builds; LilScript timing covers the kernel's three objective compiles and the five subpath packs; the ESM byte comparison covers the selected kernel only. The two lanes ran on different machines on different dates, so the times are context, not a ratio.
